mapper.insert: INSERT INTO daily_statistics ( statistics_date, total_order_count, completed_order_count, canceled_order_count, total_sales_amount, aggregated_at ) VALUES ( #{statisticsDate}, #{source.totalOrderCount}, #{source.completedOrderCount}, #{source.canceledOrderCount}, #{source.totalSalesAmount}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE total_order_count = VALUES(total_order_count), completed_order_count = VALUES(completed_order_count), canceled_order_count = VALUES(canceled_order_count), total_sales_amount = VALUES(total_sales_amount), aggregated_at = VALUES(aggregated_at)
